title: Quality Scenario — six-part scenario (SEI) with the ISO/IEC 25010:2023 vocabulary
description: Art. V: quality is not an adjective. It is a measurable scenario. Each NFR is a six-part scenario, and at least one executable test verifies it.

characteristic.description: A characteristic of ISO/IEC 25010:2023. Eight of the nine are non-functional. functional_suitability is the exception.

source.description: 1/6 — the person or the thing that starts the stimulus

stimulus.description: 2/6 — the condition that arrives at the system

artifact.description: 3/6 — the part of the system that gets the stimulus

environment.description: 4/6 — the state of the system at that time

response.description: 5/6 — the activity that occurs as a result

response_measure.description: 6/6 — the measure. Without a measure, there is no scenario: 'fast' is not a measurable response.

metric.description: for example p95 latency, recovery time, cyclomatic complexity

verified_by.description: The test contracts that verify this scenario (TC-*). The SP4 gate MUST find them.

utility_tree.description: QAW/ATAM — the priority in the utility tree
